error.invalid_access_key: EcoFlow rejected the access key (error 8513). Check the key and secret for typos, and make sure the API host matches the region your developer account belongs to: api-e.ecoflow.com for Europe, api-a.ecoflow.com for the Americas.

abort.do_reconfigure_existing: A device group with this name already exists. Reconfigure that entry instead.
abort.no_device_to_add: No new devices to add: every device in this account has already been added.
abort.remove_last_device: The last device cannot be removed. Delete the integration entry instead.

reauth_confirm.title: EcoFlow credentials rejected
reauth_confirm.description: EcoFlow no longer accepts the stored credentials for {name}. Enter the current ones to reconnect.

menu_options.hybrid: Use application API and public API (recommended)

menu_options.discover_devices: Add devices found in the account

hybrid.title: Application and public API
hybrid.description: The public API (developer keys) is used wherever it serves a device; the application API fills in the rest, such as each battery's own power and its role in a pack.

open_api_keys.title: Public API keys
open_api_keys.description: With developer keys this entry also follows the public API: online status pushes and its documented commands.

discover_devices.title: Devices in the account
discover_devices.description: Types come from the serial number. Linked STREAM batteries are grouped into a pack device automatically.

data.auto_add_devices: Add new devices of the account automatically

data.energy_update_interval_sec: Energy sensor update interval (sec, 0 = every update)

data_description.energy_update_interval_sec: Energy (kWh) sensors report at most once per interval. No energy is lost, but up to one interval's worth can be counted in the next hour's statistics, or after a utility_meter tariff switch. 60 cuts recorder writes by about 90%.
